notablePrerequisites: Thornbite Staff and Splinter Twin attached to the same legendary creature that does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate the legendary creature with Splinter Twin and Thornbite Staff attached by tapping it, creating a token copy of it with haste.
Put the token legendary creature into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the creature token dies, the legendary creature triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.
